title: viola palmata var. variabilis
intro: Viola palmata var. variabilis, commonly known as variable dog violet or variable violet, is a type of flowering plant in the viola genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola palmata var. variabilis are attributed to its calming effects, which may help alleviate anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
